You are classifying HKDSE Physics MC questions into curriculum sections.

Read the JSON file at /Users/sinchunyeung/github/paper2db/classified/llm_batches/batch_00.json
Each item has Year, Question, text (OCR of the question).

TAXONOMY (section number -> name). Pick the BEST primary section. Use a second section ONLY if genuinely cross-topic (rare).

Book 1 Heat and Gases:
1 Temperature and Heat Transfer (conduction/convection/radiation as heat transfer, thermometers, thermal equilibrium - NOT ideal-gas p-T laws)
2 Heat Capacity (c, C, specific heat, mixing calorimetry without phase change)
3 Change of State (melting/boiling/evaporation/latent heat/heating curves with plateaus)
4 Gas Law and Kinetic Theory (ideal gas, pV=nRT, p-T/p-V/V-T graphs, molecular KE, pressure from molecules)

Book 2 Force and Motion:
5 Motion (kinematics graphs, free fall without projectile framing)
6 Force (Newton laws, friction as force, F=ma, free-body basics)
7 More about Forces (systems, force resolution/addition, motion in a plane, moments/torque, CG, equilibrium of rigid body)
8 Work, Energy and Power (W=Fs, KE/PE mechanical, power, efficiency of machines)
9 Momentum (collisions, impulse, conservation of momentum)
10 Projectile Motion
11 Uniform Circular Motion (centripetal)
12 Gravitation (g, orbits, Newton's law of gravitation)

Book 3A Wave Motion:
13 Wave Motion (travelling/longitudinal/transverse waves, v=fλ, particle motion on a wave)
14 Reflection, Refraction and Diffraction (of waves; diffraction grating)
15 Interference and Stationary Wave (Young, beats, standing waves)
16 Light and Sound (EM spectrum properties, sound, ultrasound; NOT ray optics)

Book 3B Ray Optics:
17 Reflection of Light (mirrors, periscope)
18 Refraction of Light (Snell, TIR, apparent depth)
19 Lenses

Book 4 Electricity and Magnetism:
20 Electrostatics
21 Circuit and Power
22 AC and Domestic Electricity
23 Electromagnetism
24 Electromagnetic Induction

Book 5 Radioactivity and Nuclear Energy:
25 Radiation and Radioactivity (α/β/γ nature, absorption, detectors)
26 Rate of Decay and Uses of Radionuclides (half-life, activity, tracers)
27 Nuclear Energy (fission/fusion, binding energy, mass defect)

CRITICAL RULES:
- Do NOT put ideal-gas / p-T / kinetic-theory questions in section 1 just because temperature is mentioned. Example: 2012 Q3 ideal gas p vs θ -> section 4 ONLY.
- Do NOT put travelling-wave / slinky / particle-on-a-wave questions in radioactivity.
- Ignore OCR garbage; classify from meaningful physics content.
- Prefer a single section. Second section only when truly cross-topic.

Write results to /Users/sinchunyeung/github/paper2db/classified/llm_batches/batch_00_out.json as a JSON array:
[{"Year":2012,"Question":1,"sections":[2],"reason":"short reason"}, ...]
Year may be int or "pp"/"sap". Cover EVERY question in the batch. Do not skip any.
Return only a short confirmation of how many you wrote.
</user_query>
I'll read the batch file and classify every question into the taxonomy sections.
A few items have unreadable OCR; I'll check those PNGs, then write the full classification.
